product.title: BRALISSE Breast Shapewear
product.body_html:
The ultimate breast shapewear to wear all day, everyday

BRALISSE is the most comfortable and supportive breast undergarment you’ve ever worn.

Its natural fabric and unique, patented design naturally lift your breasts and shape them to perfection with ZERO underwire/hardware and TOTAL comfort.

BRALISSE gives you unbelievable support and up to 5” of lift with no wires or uncomfortable constriction thanks to its innovative crisscross design, with individual pockets/sling cups for each breast, and silky-smooth fabric.

Fit & sizing

At BRALISSE, we firmly believe that if it's your size, it should fit you perfectly. Gone are the days of grabbing a pile of bras, only to be disappointed by discomfort or an unflattering look in the fitting room.

With BRALISSE, we have designed our products to fit every woman within a specific size category. Each size of BRALISSE accommodates a combination of two band sizes and a few cup sizes, offering a remarkable range of flexibility.

We have tested BRALISSE on a diverse group of over a 100 women in all size categories and realized, that our innovative design fitted each and every body flawlessly.

How to know your BRALISSE size?

We have developed our own unique sizing system. It's easy to use. Each BRALISSE size covers a range of single sizes. Please ensure that you know your correct single size. Then based on your single size, select your BRALISSE size.

Refer to our size chart.
